Vision Board Maker

Build a vision board collage from your uploaded images and affirmations, then download it as PNG.

Add images and affirmations, then click Build Board.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload images from your device (optional).
  2. Type affirmations, one per line (optional).
  3. Click Build Board to generate the collage.
  4. Click Download PNG to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I make a vision board?

Click Upload Images and choose photos from your device, or type affirmations. Then click Build Board to lay them out on a canvas.

How is the board laid out?

The layout is automatic: images and affirmations are tiled in a grid on a 1200×900 canvas. Refresh to shuffle the order.

How do I save it?

Click Download PNG to save a 1200×900 image of your board.

Are my images uploaded anywhere?

No — uploads stay in your browser memory only for the session. Download the PNG if you want to keep the board.
